name: RE-Agent
description: RE-Agent is an automated, turnkey agentic reverse-engineering and malware analysis appliance. Features hardware QEMU/KVM virtualization, Hermes Agent with the official REA plugin, OpenBin BINNY RE harness, Ghidra 11.2+ headless, REA-Casebook for verified evidence tracking (zero-hallucination stateless case machine), static triage tools (CAPA, FLOSS, YARA, DIEC, Radare2), and a 4-layer whitelisted LLM egress firewall for safe isolated execution.

notes.text: Access the Hermes Agent Web Dashboard at http://<IP>:9119
Hermes Gateway API running on port 8642
Run 'rea-case new <sample_path>' inside the appliance to initiate an automated stateless triage and investigation
Run 're-firewall isolate <proxy_ip>' to engage strict network quarantine with whitelisted LLM egress only
Create a pristine baseline snapshot after initial boot: qm snapshot <vmid> baseline-clean
